purpose: Canonical ownership index. It routes changes to live owners and records parallel compatibility owners without declaring migration complete.

concepts.name: Source acquisition transaction and source-specific policy
concepts.allowed_extension_point: Add source-specific discovery/validation policy in its consumer, then publish only through source_acquisition.py transaction primitives.
concepts.notes: source_acquisition.py owns transactionality: validation, content hash, same-filesystem staging, fsync and atomic publication. SEC ingest and source refresh own discovery and source-specific policy, not final-path publication mechanics. Acquisition owns bytes and provenance, not economic meaning.

concepts.name: Semantic cache identity and version ownership
concepts.allowed_extension_point: Add one named semantic version here; each producer imports only relevant dimensions and keeps its payload business semantics local.
prohibited_owners: cache storage modules as global semantic owner
concepts.notes: The canonical serializer is v1_canonical_json_sha256. Live semantic dimensions include unit_norm=v1_table_local_source_unit, adjustment_domain=v1_table_role_measure_domain, document_period=v2_registered_document_identity, debt_period=v1_visual_xbrl_context, adjusted_history=v1_metric_definition_scope, inline_xbrl_text=v1_continued_at_chain and debt_rate=v1_role_period_authority.

concepts.name: Inline-XBRL fact source-text reconstruction
concepts.allowed_extension_point: New semantic consumer calls the canonical reconstruction helper before parsing; continuation behavior changes at this contract.
concepts.notes: This owner reconstructs explicit continuedAt chains and deterministic whitespace only; it does not own all XBRL parsing, contexts or document-period selection.

concepts.name: Debt-rate role and authority semantics
concepts.allowed_extension_point: Add a source-supported rate role with explicit concept/table evidence, period/basis identity, authority and mutation tests.
concepts.notes: Coupon/stated, effective, floating-base, spread/margin, all-in, conversion-related and other percentage roles remain distinct. Same-role equal-authority conflicts fail closed; occurrence remains lineage.

concepts.name: Debt facility-row duplicate ownership
concepts.allowed_extension_point: Add only economically meaningful period, facility, debt-concept, basis or scope identity dimensions and preserve contributing lineage.
concepts.notes: Identical compatible facts corroborate, explicit authority resolves compatible evidence and conflicting same-authority facts fail closed. Facility/debt fact identity is distinct from rate fact identity.

concepts.name: Fail-closed workbook finalization and publication
concepts.allowed_extension_point: Add a classified finalization stage before candidate serialization or a validator before the owning atomic promotion boundary.
concepts.notes: One nested lifecycle spans three physical modules: finalization, candidate serialization/readback validation and final CLI promotion. Material failures block publication; explicitly optional enrichment may remain non-material.

concepts.name: Quarter Notes intentionally-empty state
concepts.allowed_extension_point: A new producer must set the explicit runtime-owned state and prove valid-empty, missing, parse-failure and unexpected-empty dispositions separately.
concepts.notes: Only explicit intentionally-empty permits an empty saved readback. Parser failure, missing input and unexpected empty remain failures.

concepts.name: Derivative runtime-sheet materialization failure semantics
concepts.allowed_extension_point: Declare optional dependency absence through the module/sector contract; keep renderer/materialization errors material once a valid result exists.
concepts.notes: The declarative module/sector pack owns runtime-sheet activation. The writer owns materialization and must distinguish unavailable dependencies from failed rendering.
